svg.text: Make two, 2,318 mm long on the centre line (2,324 overall).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut each end 7 degrees off square, the two cuts parallel (the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube is a long parallelogram seen from the side): fitted, both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends stand upright against the long beams' inner faces.

svg.text: Inboard face: one 11 mm rivet nut hole 25 mm from each end, 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (front end) and 30 mm (rear end) below the top face.

svg.text: and 1,965 mm from the front end, on the centre line.
